per_ticket.description: Simple FAQ — auto-send (Gate 1 + Gate 2 pass, FAQ intent)
per_ticket.customer_message:
From: carol@example.com
Subject: How do I reset my password?

Hi, I can't log in and forgot my password. How do I reset it?
per_ticket.final_draft:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out — happy to help you get back in.

To reset your password, go to the login page and click the "Forgot password?" link, then enter the email address associated with your account. We'll send you a reset link so you can set a new password.

If the reset email doesn't arrive within a few minutes, please check your spam or junk folder. And if you run into any trouble after that, just reply here and we'll sort it out with you.

Best,
ACME Support team

Once confirmed, we'll process the refund to your original payment method.

Best,

Once we have those details, we'll dig in and get this fixed for you.
